title: Solid-state fermentation of brewer's spent grain using Rhizopus oryzae to produce a protein-rich extract with improved food functionality
projectDescription: The major side stream, brewer's spent grain (BSG), from beer production is valorized by solid-state fermentation using the edible filamentous fungi Rhizopus oryzae. A protein-rich product is made from this an its functionality a potential sustainable food ingredient is compared to an extract prepared from non-fermented BSG alongside raw BSG and raw fermented BSG. LC-MS/MS is used as a tool to perform detailed characterization of the protein composition of BSG and fermented BSG both prior and post extraction.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were prepared for LC-MS/MS analysis using the iST PreOmics kit following the manufacturer's protocol. Proteins were extracted in the provided Lyse buffer aided by focused ultrasonication.
dataProcessingProtocol: Data processing was performed using MaxQuant and Perseus. Relative iBAQ analysis was used as the major data analysis tool to make useful presentations and interpretations of the data.
